name: Integration - Agent Main Loop User Interaction
description: Tests the main agent loop for correct user interaction, including handling of 'quit' command and message processing.
input: Simulated user inputs: a valid message and then 'quit', with LLM client mocked to return a canned response.
output: Agent prints the response to the user message and exits gracefully on 'quit'.
success_criteria: Agent prints expected response for user message
